hits.snippet: * Home * Research & Development * Norstella launches Atlas, an agentic AI platform built on biopharma's most connected data # Norstella launches Atlas, an agentic AI platform built on biopharma's most connected data Published: 7-Aug-2026 Research & Development New platform combines Norstella's proprietary data assets with purpose-built AI agents to deliverdecision-ready outputs across the drug development lifecycle Norstella, the connected data foundation the life sciences industry relies on, today launched [Norstella Atlas](https://ai.norstella.com/) , an agentic AI platform that turns that foundation into finished, decision-ready work. For decades, Norstella has been ingesting, curating, linking, tokenizing, and refining trillions of disparate data points to surface the insights that matter most across the drug development lifecycle.
